package.name: deep_bridge
package.description: Bridges geometry_msgs/Twist cmd_vel to Deep Robotics Lynx M20S's UDP/JSON body-monitoring protocol. The axis command is paired with the usage mode, selected by the usage_mode parameter: regular mode sends the normalized axis command (Type 0x00100001, Command 0x00100002, values are a fraction of maximum speed), navigation mode sends the real axis command (Command 0x00110002, values are m/s and rad/s). A safety watchdog stops the robot when cmd_vel stops arriving, when the robot's own status reports (hard e-stop, usage mode, motion state, gait) say it isn't safe to drive, or when those reports themselves go stale. Transport is UDP, plain or DTLS-encrypted (use_dtls), with a 16-byte header + JSON ASDU body, so this package implements the framing itself (see include/deep_bridge/UdpProtocol.h) instead of depending on a vendor SDK. JSON parsing uses a vendored single-header nlohmann/json (include/deep_bridge/json.hpp, MIT licensed) rather than adding a system package dependency.
